ImageDescription.value: Konrad Hermann Joseph Adenauer (5 January 1876 – 19 April 1967) was a German statesman who served as the first Chancellor of the Federal Republic of Germany (West Germany) from 1949 to 1963. He led his country from the ruins of World War II to a productive and prosperous nation that forged close relations with France, the United Kingdom and the United States. During his years in power, West Germany achieved democracy, stability, international respect and economic prosperity ("Wirtschaftswunder"). He was the first leader of the Christian Democratic Union (CDU).

ImageDescription.value:
Telescope on the observation deck of the Eiffel Tower, Paris, France
The Eiffel Tower is the most famous landmark in Paris. It was built for the 1889 World’s Fair to mark the 100th anniversary of the French Revolution. The 324-meter-high tower was designed by engineer Gustave Eiffel and his team.
Construction began in 1887 and took just over two years. At the time of its completion, the Eiffel Tower was the tallest structure in the world. Initially, the iron structure was criticized by many artists and intellectuals, but it soon became a symbol of modern engineering.
Originally, the tower was supposed to be dismantled after 20 years. However, its importance for radio and telecommunications technology ensured its preservation. The Eiffel Tower is one of the most visited tourist attractions in the world and stands as a symbol of Paris, France, and the technological age of the 19th century.

ImageDescription.value:
Redstart (Phoenicurus phoenicurus) male ringed, Għadira Nature Reserve, Malta.
Bird ringing is a vital activity that helps protect birds. In Malta, birds are humanely caught in mist nets which are checked every ten minutes. Each bird is ringed and weighed before being released. About 10% are retraps (i.e. they have been ringed before). Ringing has shown that birds from at least 48 countries use Malta during migration. Unfortunately, Malta has the densest population of bird hunters in the European Union. The high numbers of wild birds illegally shot in Malta has led to the European Commission taking legal infringement proceedings against the Maltese Government over Article 5 of the Birds Directive. Many thanks to BirdLife Malta for access to their ringing programme.
